questions.question: Who advised Moses to appoint capable men to help judge the people?
What was Moses doing alone that wore him out?
options: Judging all the people's disputes himself
Leading the worship at the altar alone
Building the tabernacle with his own hands
Standing guard over the camp each night
questions.answer: Judging all the people's disputes himself
